_comment: Cross edge insertion algorithms. White cross on U face. Each case describes the position/orientation of a white-face edge piece and the moves to insert it correctly. Cases are keyed by: target_slot (UF/UR/UB/UL), source_face (where the edge currently is), and orientation (0=correct, 1=flipped).

CROSS_SETUP._comment: Before applying any case algorithm, AUF (Adjust U Face) rotations may be needed to align the target slot. U, U', U2 are used freely between insertions.

FROM_BOTTOM._comment: Edge is in the D layer. These are the most common starting positions after a scramble.

DF_correct._comment: Edge at DF, white facing down, target is UF

DF_flipped._comment: Edge at DF, white facing front, target is UF

DR_correct._comment: Edge at DR, white facing down, target is UR

DR_flipped._comment: Edge at DR, white facing right, target is UR

DB_correct._comment: Edge at DB, white facing down, target is UB

DB_flipped._comment: Edge at DB, white facing back, target is UB

DL_correct._comment: Edge at DL, white facing down, target is UL

DL_flipped._comment: Edge at DL, white facing left, target is UL

FROM_MIDDLE._comment: Edge is stuck in the E (middle) layer. Must be extracted before inserting.

FR_white_front._comment: Edge at FR, white facing front, target is UF

FR_white_right._comment: Edge at FR, white facing right, target is UF

RB_white_right._comment: Edge at RB, white facing right, target is UR

RB_white_back._comment: Edge at RB, white facing back, target is UR

BL_white_back._comment: Edge at BL, white facing back, target is UB

BL_white_left._comment: Edge at BL, white facing left, target is UB

LF_white_left._comment: Edge at LF, white facing left, target is UL

LF_white_front._comment: Edge at LF, white facing front, target is UL

FROM_TOP_FLIPPED._comment: Edge reached U layer but is flipped (non-white facing up). Must be corrected.

UF_flipped._comment: Edge at UF position but flipped

UR_flipped._comment: Edge at UR position but flipped

UB_flipped._comment: Edge at UB position but flipped

UL_flipped._comment: Edge at UL position but flipped

DAISY_METHOD._comment: Alternative: build a daisy on U (white stickers facing up on U layer edges), then flip each edge into place with F2/R2/B2/L2.
